title: Power Apps: row summaries in model-driven apps reach GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, administrative paths, licensing and credit consumption are supported. The environment settings API is documented despite the automated warning, and the briefing explicitly reports the conflicting Learn descriptions of defaults and configuration scope.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The environment control is at Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Summary > Row summaries > environment > Edit setting.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Copilot, and then select Settings. Under Power Apps, locate Row summaries in the Summary section. Select the environment, and then select Edit setting.

claims.claim: The Power Platform API updates environment settings through PATCH /environmentmanagement/environments/{environmentId}/settings?api-version=2024-10-01.
claims.quote: Update fields on the environment management setting. PATCH https://api.powerplatform.com/environmentmanagement/environments/{environmentId}/settings?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.claim: powerApps_EnableFormInsights is the boolean environment management setting used by the API at version 2024-10-01.
claims.quote: API Version: 2024-10-01; EnvironmentManagementSetting; powerApps_EnableFormInsights | boolean

claims.claim: EnableFormInsights is the shared AI insight cards setting.
claims.quote: The canvas grid also checks the shared AI insight cards (EnableFormInsights) setting and whether AI prompts are enabled.

claims.claim: The maker control is at Power Apps > Tables > table > Customizations > Row summary > Show row summary.
claims.quote: In Power Apps, select Tables on the left navigation pane, and open the table with the configured row summary. Under Customizations, select Row summary. In the prompt configuration screen, use the Show row summary toggle

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The configuration guide describes summaries applying to all main forms and views for the table.
claims.quote: When you configure the row summary, it applies to all views and main forms for the table.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls; Governance controls table
claims.claim: Show row summary hides only custom summaries configured through this experience, not Microsoft-provided or other-app summaries.
claims.quote: The Show row summary toggle affects only custom row summaries configured from this row summary experience. It doesn't hide summaries provided by Microsoft or summaries configured through another application or experience

Read configure-form-row-summary and ai-skill-config-table; no deciding property or operation documented.
